Young Indians increasingly experiencing heart attacks, studies suggest

Multiple Indian media outlets are reporting on a concerning trend of heart attacks affecting younger individuals in India. Studies and expert opinions suggest factors like diabetes and silent cardiovascular disease contribute to this rise, often without prior warning signs. This phenomenon highlights a growing public health concern regarding cardiovascular health in the Indian population.
